summary.text: Jeff Newlin is the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Kim Jackson.
A business executive who now leads the Georgia Ready Mixed Concrete Association, he was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2024, when Jackson defeated him.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Newlin was born in Indiana and earned a high school diploma from Western High School and a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 1989, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a small town in rural Indiana and spent 37 years in the private sector building and leading technology companies, most recently as Chief Revenue Officer of Command Alkon.
He said he is now Executive Director of the Georgia Ready Mixed Concrete Association.
Newlin said he has lived in the Atlanta area for 36 years, the last 15 in the Lakeside area of DeKalb County.
He ran for District 41 in 2024, when Kim Jackson received 81.8% of the vote to his 18.2%.
His 2026 campaign priorities, as he described them in the survey, are income and property tax relief, school choice and workforce development, and public safety and support for veterans.
